donorReadme: - Source: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Space Science Institute/Lunar and Planetary Institute Color Maps of Enceladus - 2014 (PIA18435)
- Purpose: web-ready simple-cylindrical Enceladus texture for the Saturn moon pack
- Processing: resized locally from the oversized `15960x7980` checked-in source image to a true `4096x2048` JPEG
- Credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/Space Science Institute/Lunar and Planetary Institute

coordinates.placement: latLonToXYZ in the donor src/entities/hotspot.ts, on Three.js SphereGeometry UVs
coordinates.longitudeDegrees: exactly as stored in features.json, placed by latLonToXYZ whatever the range; the donor stores values already in its own marker frame (see longitudeRange, markerLongitudeFromSource and donorReadmeNote)
coordinates.position: [radius * sin(phi) * sin(theta), radius * cos(phi), radius * sin(phi) * cos(theta)]
coordinates.conventionNote: donor: visually calibrated against the rendered texture; raw positive-west values must be converted before use
coordinates.donorReadmeNote: - The current Enceladus release uses the NASA/JPL PIA18435 Cassini global map resized to `4K`. Feature coordinates in `data/enceladus-features.json` are visually calibrated against the rendered texture and coordinate readout; raw IAU positive-west, 0-360 longitude anchors must be converted before use.
